Create exactly one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, a new original hand-drawn illustration, landscape 16:9, 1536 x 864 pixels or larger at the same ratio. No additional variants.

Use case: illustration-story / Japanese sports-news thumbnail.
Style: approved basketball-summary visual direction: near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm off-white. Bold Japanese sans-serif headline, energetic rough ink strokes, dry brush and small ink flecks, just a few strong elements. Clearly drawn illustration, not photorealistic, no photograph pasted into artwork.
Composition: LEFT 44 percent contains one large real basketball player's dynamic three-quarter body driving forward to the left with knees bent, torso leaning, cradling an orange basketball at hip height with both hands as he moves. Face visible in front three-quarter view; both hands have natural distinct fingers correctly resting around the ball. Head, elbows, hands and the whole ball safely inside the canvas. Crop only lower legs if necessary. Broad lime brush arc behind the player. RIGHT 52 percent has calm dark negative space for text, with ample outer margins and no collisions. This is an imagined action pose, never a reconstruction of a specific real game.

Subject identity: Koki Hosaka (保坂晃毅), the real Kumamoto Volters player, randomly selected from the current official roster of a team mentioned in the fixed article. Use his inspected official portrait as the visual likeness guide: young Japanese adult male, short dense wavy black hair, gently separated near center at the front with lifted volume on top and close short sides, visible ears; oval face with a slightly squared jaw and rounded chin; straight thick dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, straight medium-length nose, closed medium-width lips, clean-shaven (no beard, no mustache), light-medium warm skin, athletic lean muscular shoulders and arms. The official portrait was checked at https://www.volters.jp/team/players/detail/id=16185?PlayerID=51000450 and its official image https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026110819/files/user/roster/724/2026-27/51000450_01.jpg . These are identity references only.
Render him with rich black/ivory ink hatching and restrained skin color; plain red basketball jersey and shorts with dark trim, no lettering, no number, no logos, no sponsor marks. The orange ball is a held prop. No other people.

Text: render ONLY the following strings, exactly and legibly:
- small masthead at top right: 「バスケまとめ」
- medium lime category below masthead: 「B.ONE / B.NEXT」
- enormous bold lime date: 「11/28」

Do not include the Japanese quotation marks in rendered text. Use exact Japanese characters and half-width Latin letters/digits as above.
The main headline should be immediately readable when reduced to a small thumbnail. Keep footer and qualifier large enough to read at full size.

The randomly chosen player's illustration is only an image and does not claim he played this day. Do not copy Culver or Faison names, dates, or results from the style reference. No team or league logo, no watermark, no photorealism. Preserve the required AI label.
